surprise

n. 惊奇；意外之事

短语：big surprise — 大惊喜；大吃一惊

短语：catch by surprise — 使吃惊，使诧异，使感到意外
例句：The man had a look of surprise on his face.

immediately
音标：英 /ɪ'miːdɪətlɪ/  美 /ɪ'midɪətli/

n. 差别；差异

短语：finite difference method — 有限差分法
短语：pressure difference — 压力差；差压；压力补偿器；气压梯度
短语：difference from — 与…不同
短语：time difference — n. 时差
短语：color difference — 色差，色彩差异
短语：phase difference — 相位差
短语：cultural difference — 文化差异
短语：price difference — 价格差别

短语：potential difference — n. 势差，位差
短语：essential difference — 本质区别
短语：difference equation — [计]差分方程，差分方程式

短语：difference in temperature — 温差
例句：(= there’s a very big difference ) between us.
我们之间有着天壤之别。

accept
音标：英 /əkˈsept/  美 /əkˈsɛpt/
v. 收受；接受
短语：accept of — v. 承兑
例句：Rick accepted her offer of coffee.
她请里克喝咖啡，他接受了。
例句：He accepted the invitation to stay with us.
他接受了邀请来我们家住。
例句：His school reports said that he is always ready to accept a challenge (=  agree to do something difficult  ) .
他的学业报告上说他乐于接受挑战。
例句：Please accept this small gift.
请收下这份小小的礼物。
例句：They offered me a job and I accepted.
他们给我一份工作，我接受了。
例句：He readily accepted her invitation (=  accepted it quickly  ) .
他欣然接受了她的邀请。

tradition
音标：英 /trə'dɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /trə'dɪʃən/
n. 传统习俗
短语：cultural tradition — 文化传统
短语：by tradition — 照传统；根据口传
短语：oral tradition — 口头传统；口传；口传
例句：the traditions of South East Asia
东南亚的传统
例句：the tradition that the eldest son inherits the property
长子继承家产的传统
例句：By tradition, it’s the bride’s parents who pay for the wedding.
根据传统习俗，婚礼的费用由新娘的父母承担。
